stem: A harvest team wants one universal trichome threshold for every cultivar, but prior records show different sensory and maturation outcomes at the same visual state. What is the strongest recommendation?
choices: Use cultivar-specific, representative maturity evidence and validated product goals rather than imposing one universal visual threshold
Use the universal threshold because visual categories are identical across genetics
Harvest only by days since flip
rationale: Maturity interpretation can vary by genotype, sampling position and product goal, so validated cultivar-specific evidence is more defensible than a universal threshold.
